Dana, I saved a draft to Hollis, but I left the rate out of it.

The draft is in your mailbox, subject "Quarrendon 2026 rate", addressed to hmbeki@pemberline.com. The body has a placeholder where the $2,356 figure goes. Nothing has been sent.

I held the rate back because per-seat rates are finance figures. Even though you own the account, they can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark, and you, and Hollis is none of those. I've asked June by DM for approval to include it. Once she or Anselm approves, put the figure in the placeholder and send it yourself. Or, if you'd rather, I can tell you when June has replied.
